summary: Iteration 3 fully tested. Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_iteration3.py with 14 pytest cases — all PASS (52/52 including iteration 1+2). Verified: /api/auth/login now returns modules map with all 7 keys (APM+DIGITAL_TWIN default true, rest default false, all booleans); GET /api/modules returns 7 objects with key/name/description/enabled; PUT /api/modules/EEMS {enabled:true} as TENANT_ADMIN returns 200 and persists; PUT /api/modules/APM as CXO returns 403; disabling APM causes GET /api/assets to return 403 with 'APM' in detail, and re-enabling restores 200; GET /api/users as TENANT_ADMIN returns exactly 5 users with role+employee_id, operator row has assigned_asset.asset_code=='CNC-DEMO-01'; GET /api/users as OPERATOR returns 403; PUT /api/users/{op}/assign as SUPERVISOR with a Press asset returns 200 and persists (asset_code changed), reset to CNC-DEMO-01 works; PUT /api/users/{op}/assign as OPERATOR returns 403; PUT /api/users/{tenant_admin}/assign returns 400 (only operators); invalid asset id returns 404; /api/dashboard/summary?plant_id=<Pune> returns total_assets 45–47 (< unfiltered 63), recent_alarms all scoped to Pune assets; /api/assets?plant_id=<Mumbai> returns exactly 8 Mumbai assets; toggling REPORTS broadcasts {type:'modules', modules:{...}} over WebSocket to authenticated tenant listener. Frontend: TA sidebar shows 'Users' and 'Module Access'; /modules renders all 7 module cards with switches; toggling EEMS shows success toast and card flips to Active; /users renders 5 rows and only Operator has 'Assign machine' button; opening dialog + selecting a different asset + Save shows toast and reload confirms new assignment (then reset back to CNC-DEMO-01); Header shows Factory 'Plant switcher' after tenant selector defaulting to 'All Plants'; selecting Pune Plant drops Dashboard Total Assets 63→47 and assets_by_area shows only Pune areas (Forging Area / Utilities / HeatTreatment / Storage / Main Line); /assets while Pune selected shows only Pune Plant rows (no Mumbai/Nashik), switching back to All Plants restores full list; CXO login → /cxo; selecting Mumbai Plant highlights cxo-row-MUM-01 with 'bg-blue-50/60 ring-1 ring-inset ring-[color:var(--brand-blue)]/40' classes; disabling APM removes Assets + Asset Hierarchy links from sidebar AND direct /assets navigation redirects to /dashboard; re-enabled APM afterwards. Regression: Operator login still lands on /operator with runbook UI intact. Iteration 1+2 backend suite still 38/38 green.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1395 lines. Same as iteration 2 flag — split into routers (modules.py, users.py, dashboard.py, telemetry.py) to stay under the 700-line-per-file guideline.

get_tenant_modules() lazily seeds tenant_modules on first read. Combined with default APM=true/DIGITAL_TWIN=true this is correct, but there is no unique index on tenant_modules.tenant_id — under concurrent first-boot requests two docs could be inserted. Add a unique index on tenant_id.
/api/users returns password-stripped docs via projection ({'password':0}) — good. It does not paginate; will scale up to 500 users. Add cursor/pagination before onboarding large tenants.

PUT /api/users/{id}/assign uses find_one then update_one; small TOCTOU window when Supervisor and Tenant Admin race — for a single-operator demo this is fine, but consider using a single find_one_and_update with $set to keep atomicity.

Frontend PlantContext persists selectedPlantId in localStorage keyed 'coreot_plant' but is not cleared on logout — if a different user logs in on the same browser the previous plant filter carries over. Consider clearing coreot_plant in auth.logout().

Layout.jsx plant switcher is rendered for all authenticated users including Operator; on the Operator role the operator page ignores the plant filter (it uses my-machine) so this is a no-op but is visually confusing. Hide plant switcher for OPERATOR (BareProtected) role.

ModulesPage optimistic update on toggle is nice, but on failure it reverts only that card — it does NOT re-fetch, so if the server disabled a downstream module in a cascade the UI would be stale. After refreshModules(), consider load() as well.
test_credentials: From /app/memory/test_credentials.md (Tenant SBF, 5 roles). INGEST_KEY from /app/backend/.env (masked, not logged).

Operator assignment ends at CNC-DEMO-01. Modules ended at defaults: APM=true, DIGITAL_TWIN=true, EEMS/OEE_APS/AI_COPILOT/REPORTS/AUDIT=false.
context_for_next_testing_agent: For iteration-3 use /app/backend/tests/test_iteration3.py; it toggles APM off then on inside test_apm_gate_on_assets via try/finally so downstream tests are safe. WebSocket broadcast test toggles REPORTS to true, so if a future test asserts REPORTS default=false, reset it first. Frontend tests must wait for [data-testid=module-card-APM] (not just modules-page) before counting cards — the header renders before the useEffect fetch completes. Table pagination shows 10 rows per page on /assets, so validate plant filter by scanning row text for plant name (not row count).
rca of the issue: No functional issues found — Iteration 3 features (Module Activation, Users list + Assign Machine, Plant filter switcher, APM gate) all work end-to-end. Only code-review-level recommendations reported above.
